## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New or changed rule
- [ ] Importer, recorder or integration
- [ ] Report format or CLI
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or chore

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] `pytest` passes and new behaviour has tests
- [ ] New rules have a detection test and a no-false-positive test
- [ ] No real traces, credentials or personal data included
